ops.title: Fleet cleanup: stale .graphite_repo_config deleted from cc-context, cc-review, cc-transcript
ops.body:
Done 2026-07-28, after T1 (`2db5214a`) was verified — deliberately in that order, because cc-context's config was T1's only live fixture and deleting it first would have destroyed the thing under test.

## What was removed

All three were 161 bytes, and all three were genuinely stale — `gt auth --no-interactive` exits 1 in each with "Graphite does not have the necessary permissions to submit PRs to yasyf/<repo>", confirmed across 24 measurement runs:

| repo | config mtime |
|---|---|
| cc-context | 2026-07-28 14:18 (refreshed by the probe runs; `gt auth` rewrites `.graphite_pr_info`/metadata) |
| cc-review | 2026-07-24 23:03 |
| cc-transcript | 2026-07-22 03:17 |

Copies kept at `/tmp/graphite-config-backup-<repo>.json` — ephemeral, and not worth preserving: `gt init`/`gt create` regenerates one, which is exactly how the last incident put one back.

## Effect

```
cc-context      1561ms  {"lane":"git","graphite":{"config":false,"cli":false}}
cc-review       4566ms  {"lane":"jj", "graphite":{"config":false,"cli":false}}
cc-transcript   3000ms  {"lane":"git","graphite":{"config":false,"cli":false}}
```

No graphite block beyond `config: false`, and **no probe cost** — these commands no longer pay the 7–20s `gt auth` round trip that a live config forces. (`cli: false` is not a claim that `gt` is off PATH; `infoGraphite` returns early once `config` is false and never populates it.)

## Why deletion rather than `git config ccx.nogt true`

Chosen by yasyf over the config-flag alternative. The flag would suppress the lane while leaving the stale artifact in place to confuse the next reader; deletion restores each repo to its genuine state. The tradeoff accepted: nothing prevents a stray `gt init`/`gt create` from recreating one. That is not hypothetical — it is how cc-skills acquired the config that reproduced T1 live on 2026-07-27.

The v0.39.0 gate is the real backstop here. Even with a config present, a repo Graphite refuses now demotes to jj/git with the reason on the report line, so a recreated config costs one probe rather than a failed `gt submit`. Deleting the configs is hygiene; the gate is the fix.

Untouched: `Forge-AI/monorepo` and `interview-tools`, whose Graphite configs are legitimate.
